coder_notes: Retifanlimab is the only non-excluded investigational agent (vaccine is an excluded type), so experimental_monotherapy; regimen combination because of the vaccine. Step 1 requires IDH wildtype but Step 2 states IDH1/2-mutant secondary glioblastoma will not be excluded; coded cns5 per both-criteria rule. Neoantigen availability is a vaccine-manufacturing requirement and is not matched to retifanlimab. Target engagement coded yes from the planned T-cell/MDSC immunophenotyping, which is partly vaccine-driven; adjudicator may reconsider.
